Transitions.ErrorBack: Go back to the previous action
Transitions.FeatureDescription: Transitions is a report showing the things your visitors did directly before and after viewing a given page. This page explains how to access, understand, and use the powerful "Transitions" report.
Transitions.AvailableInOtherReports: Did you know? Transitions are also available as a row action in the following reports:
Transitions.AvailableInOtherReports2: Launch transitions by clicking their icon (%s) after hovering a row in any of these reports.
Transitions.NoDataForActionDetails: Either the action had no pageviews during the period, or it is invalid.
Transitions.PeriodNotAllowedDetails: Try selecting a period with fewer days for this feature.
Transitions.PreprocessedPageAddedNewDataOnly: Added. Only new data will be prepared for this page.
Transitions.PreprocessedPageAddedRebuild: Added. Data for the past %s months is prepared during the next archiving runs.
Transitions.PreprocessedPageDuplicateHelp: http://, https:// and www. variants count as the same page, and excluded query parameters are ignored.
Transitions.PreprocessedPageInvalidUrl: Please enter a valid page URL starting with http:// or https://.
Transitions.PreprocessedPageNotSelected: This page is not selected for pre-processed Transitions.
Transitions.PreprocessedPagesBusy: Another change to the pre-processed pages of this website is in progress. Please try again.
Transitions.PreprocessedPagesEmpty: No pages selected yet. Add the pages your team analyses most, such as the home page, landing pages or checkout steps.
Transitions.PreprocessedPagesIntro: The Transitions report for these pages is prepared during archiving, so it opens quickly for long periods and keeps working after raw visit data is deleted. Other pages use raw data as before.
Transitions.PreprocessedPagesLimitReached: You can select at most %s pages for pre-processed Transitions.
Transitions.PreprocessedPagesLimitReachedHelp: The limit of %s pages is reached. Remove a page to add this one.
Transitions.PreprocessedPagesNewDataOnlyHint: Only new data will be prepared for this page.
Transitions.PreprocessedPagesOverLimit: %1$s pages are selected, more than the current limit of %2$s. All %1$s are still prepared. Remove %3$s pages to add new ones.
Transitions.PreprocessedPagesRebuildHint: Newly added pages are prepared for the past %s months during the next archiving runs. Until then, the report uses raw data.
Transitions.PreprocessedPagesSuggestions: Most viewed matching pages · last 30 days
Transitions.PreprocessedPageUrlTooLong: The page URL is too long. Use at most %s characters.
Transitions.PluginDescription: Reports previous and following actions for each page URL in a new "Transitions" report, available in the "Actions" reports via a new icon.
Transitions.ShareOfAllPageviews: This page had %1$s pageviews (%2$s of all pageviews)
Transitions.XOfAllPageviews: %s of all views of this page
Transitions.StopPreprocessingHelp: Data already prepared stays available; new data won't be prepared.
Transitions.TransitionsSubcategoryHelp1: Transitions is a report showing the things your visitors did directly before and after viewing a given page. This page explains how to access, understand, and use the powerful "Transitions" report.
Transitions.UnknownUserHelp: This user has since been deleted.
